about_the_game:
ARES 2192 is an open-world racing adventure set on a terraformed Mars where you navigate extreme environments that can be used to your advantage. Forge a Neural Bond with your vehicle's AI companion and compete in illegal underground races that are broadcast across the solar system. Master the chaotic forces of a planet being violently reshaped terraforming.

Race on non-linear tracks through hazards like massive tornados, using them as gravitational slingshots to gain extraordinary speed advantages – or risk catastrophic failure if your timing is off. Navigate treacherous Martian landscapes meticulously recreated from NASA topographical data, choosing between safe paths or high-risk routes with greater rewards.

Your AI companion evolves based on your racing style, developing unique abilities and uncovering the mysteries behind Mars' "Year Zero" incident. Each race deepens your Neural Bond while building your vehicle's value in the underground racing economy.

Key Features:

  • Evolving AI Companions: Develop a unique Neural Bond with your vehicle's AI, adapting to your racing style and unlocking new capabilities as your relationship grows.

  • Dynamic Weather Systems: Transform environmental hazards into strategic advantages with our physics-based tornado mechanics that create both dangers and opportunities.

  • Cross-Platform Ecosystem: Seamlessly switch between quick mobile sessions and deeper PC gameplay while maintaining your progression, vehicle customizations, and AI development.

  • Non-Linear Racing: Choose your path with our dynamic checkpoint system – safe routes offer standard points, while dangerous paths near hazards provide multiplied rewards.

  • Player-Driven Economy: Trade vehicles with developed AI companions that have unique abilities based on their racing history, creating a marketplace where your training efforts have tangible value.

  • Deep Narrative Experience: Uncover the truth behind Mars' mysterious terraforming project through environmental storytelling and your evolving relationship with your AI companion.

  • Authentic Martian Geography: Race across accurately modeled Martian terrain based on real NASA data, reimagined through the lens of futuristic terraforming technology.

Developed by industry veterans from franchises like BioShock, Saints Row, Halo, and Forza, ARES 2192 delivers a fresh take on racing that combines high-octane competition with narrative depth and strategic environmental mastery.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • VR Support: Not Supported
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for optimal performance

Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT

short_description: A sci-fi, open world racing adventure where you bond with your vehicle's AI while facing the extreme conditions of a planet Mars being violently reshaped by terraforming. Master physics-defying racing, build your reputation in illegal races, and explore to uncover the secrets of ARES 2192.
